violations.description: Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. -Two paper towel dispensers had dead batteries, would not dispense paper towels. -Hand sink at drive through does not have a paper towel dispenser installed.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --Lockers or other suitable facilities were not provided for the orderly storage of employees' clothing/ possessions. -Employee storage area does not have separate storage for in-use aprons and personal coats/items. -"Break room" area is crowed and does not have space for employee items.
